lines.text: Many learners say: Thanks you very much.
Thank you! Thank you very much.

native.tip: 中文说“谢谢你”，很多人就直译成 thanks you。英语要说 Thank you，或者只说 Thanks。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Thanks you very much.”😅 中文说“谢谢你”，但英语要说 Thank you：“Thank you very much.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Thank you very much.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese, you say “thanks” and “you,” so many learners say “thanks you.” English says “thank you” or just “thanks.”
en.caption: Do you say “Thanks you very much.” 😅 English says thank you: “Thank you very much.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
